description: Upstream image updates, offered as PRs on Monday mornings. Merging into master deploys (README "Deploying"), so nothing merges by itself.

customManagers.description: Images the scripts run directly: curl on the internal network, Caddy for the password hash, Postgres for the restore test, Alpine for the attachments archive
Images the CI workflows run directly: shellcheck. Its tags are vX.Y.Z

packageRules.description: Our own images (the forks' and the suggester's) are pinned by .github/workflows/pin.yml when their code changes
Firefly III tags are version-x.y.z. It migrates its database on start
prBodyNotes: Merging deploys it: the server backs up, proves the backup restores, then starts the new version, which migrates the database. Read the release notes of every version this crosses.

packageRules.description: A new Postgres major needs a dump and restore by hand; never offer one
